works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 营销活动追踪、响应分析与沟通记录同屏排布，CRM 类产品可借鉴其多渠道消息的统一信息架构。
works.comment_en: Campaign tracking, response analytics, and communication logs on one screen — CRM products can borrow its unified IA for multi-channel messaging.
works.title: CRM & Communication Management Dashboard UI Design

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 制造业质量管理 Web 应用，批次放行概览、缺陷热力图与纠正措施看板分区清晰，工业类后台的数据密度排布范例。
works.comment_en: Manufacturing quality-management web app: batch-release overview, defect heatmap, and corrective-action boards in clear zones — a data-density model for industrial back offices.
works.title: Quality Management System Web App Design

works.author: Sujon Hossain
works.comment: AI 智能体研究工作区概念，四步计划、逐行填充表格与引用来源编排顺畅，研究型 AI 产品的流程可视化值得参考。
works.comment_en: AI agent research-workspace concept: four-step plan, row-by-row table fills, and cited sources arranged smoothly — process visualization worth referencing for research AI products.
works.title: Fennel – AI Agent Research Workspace

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 银行数字账户门户，余额卡、投资组合追踪与交易热力图层级分明，金融类门户的首屏信息组织可借鉴。
works.comment_en: Bank digital-account portal; balance cards, portfolio tracking, and a transaction heatmap in clear layers — a good above-the-fold model for finance portals.
works.title: Bank Website - Digital Account Portal

works.author: Tanvir for Yscale Studio
works.comment: 家具电商网站首页，大图留白与商品卡片节奏舒服，家居类电商可参考其首屏叙事。
works.comment_en: Furniture e-commerce homepage; big-image whitespace and product-card rhythm feel comfortable — a good first-screen narrative for home-goods stores.
works.title: Furniture Store Website Design | Kasaform — E-commerce

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: 医疗沟通平台，医生-患者消息、预约与患者管理同屏呈现，医患类产品的三栏信息架构清晰。
works.comment_en: Healthcare communication platform: doctor-patient messages, appointments, and patient management on one screen — a clear three-column IA for care products.
works.title: Healthcare Communication Dashboard – Doctor & Patient Platform

works.author: Awe Design Studio
works.comment: 物流企业落地页，海运风主视觉配即时运单追踪入口，B2B 服务类站点的信任感营造值得学。
works.comment_en: Logistics company landing page: maritime hero visual plus an instant tracking entry — trust-building worth studying for B2B service sites.
works.title: Shipping and Logistic operations Website

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 鸟鸣识别 iOS 应用，实时声谱图、物种置信度与叫声对比的展示方式新颖，AI 识别类 App 的结果呈现可参考。
works.comment_en: Bird-song identifier iOS app: real-time spectrogram, species confidence, and call comparison presented in novel ways — a good result-presentation reference for AI recognition apps.
works.title: Bird Song Identifier Mobile iOS App Design
